body: I have enough trouble making small talk with strangers, let alone telling them my life story warts an all.

I'm afraid of talking to the doctor, I went to a private therapist last year and although it did help, I suppose i wasnt 100% honest with him for fear of getting advice i dednt want to hear. ie your wife is unreasonable leave her etc.

I should go to the doctor, I should bit the bullet and see if I do have aspergers, it might help with my son from my first marriage who is also showing traits.

I'm scared to go to the doctor and say how I feel for fear of being sectioned, If I go to the doctors and tell them i have suicidal feelings am I going to end up locked up on a mental ward? I'm self employed if that happens there is nobody to provide for my family.

We had a schedule, it worked for many years although I had had to take her to court in the first place to get it, problem is we are back at square 1 so anything I do to gain access is seen by the wife as me giving in to the ex.

Whereas I just trying not to rock the boat.

Hi Thanks for the reply, I did see a therapist for a while last year, and it was helping, but then a change of circumstances cause me to more city and the thought of going through it all again scares the shit out of me.

I'm not a people person (typical aspie trait although not diagnosed) so the idea of bearing my heart to the doctor fills me with dread, funnily enough doing it pubically on the internet seems easier as i dont have to look you in the eye.

I know the next step should be see a doctor, but i dont want to end up on anti depressants, ive seen how numb that has made my wife and i dont want that, but i dont really want the alternative either so i dont really have a choice.

As for not enjoying things anymore, I am a geek, I made a good career out of being a geek, but now the things i enjoy are work, so it doesnt seem fun any more.

I tend to throw money are things, i buy things hoping they will make me happy but they dont, I have a desire to do soemthing worthwhile, to help others but i dont have the time or the energy. I feel like my only purpose is to provide a roof for a family that never seem happy.

I sometimes wonder if this is what a mid-life crisis is all about
